_about: Proposed voicebanks[] and vocoders[] for https://resonance.plok.org/index.json (docs/history/specs/vocal-mcp-control-and-quality.md §5; docs/features/compose/voicebank-library.md). Merge into the served index next to drumkits[]; the server copy is the live one. url is always the creator's own download — never rehost. Verified 2026-10-07 with the GitHub releases API (gh api repos/<repo>/releases/tags/<tag>): url, bytes and, where GitHub publishes an asset digest, sha256. Terms, credit and commercial come from docs/history/research/singing-voicebank-options-2026-notes/. Fields under _unverified were not checked against a primary source. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the app.

voicebanks.name: TIGER
voicebanks._note: languages per the DiffSinger Wiki (diffsinger-english-ecosystem.md §1): English, Japanese and Mandarin primary; Spanish and French secondary; Italian, PT-BR, Thai, Russian, Korean, Polish and German through XLS.

_unverified.sha256: GitHub publishes no digest for this 2024 asset; download and hash it before publishing (sha256sum TIGER_DS_v106_PACK.zip), or leave it out and the download is not verified
_unverified.credit: the exact credit wording is in the TOS at tigermeat.xyz, which the research did not retrieve
_unverified.layout: whether the PACK zip holds the bank folder alone (the installer strips one wrapper and drops files outside the dsconfig.yaml branch) was not checked

voicebanks.name: LIEE Lilia (MM 2.8 JubiLIEE)
voicebanks._note: Terms, quoted from the LIEE ToU (licensing-and-integration.md, diffsinger-english-ecosystem.md): exported audio may be used commercially without permission, credited as 'LIEE'; 'You cannot use LIEE in AI-generated music and other generative AI contexts'; 'Please contact the Creator if you would like to port LIEE to another singing synthesizer program.' D9 accepts the generative-AI clause while Resonance is not commercial; ask julieraptor (liee.immortal.idol@gmail.com) before any commercial release.

_unverified.changes: the v170 release notes are empty; known from its zip (central directory, 2026-10-13): the acoustic config sits in configs/ (v160: configs/configs/) and its speaker embeddings are 384 wide (hidden_size 384; v160: 256), which Resonance reads since 2026-10-13. How it sounds next to v160 was not compared

voicebanks.name: Katyusha (LUNAI)
voicebanks._note: Verified 2026-10-13: url, bytes and sha256 from the GitHub releases API (release 170); languages from the bank's 'about voicebank.txt' (native Russian; Arabic, listed without a phonemizer, left out), speakers from configs/character.yaml; the zip holds configs/, files/ and tgm_hifigan/ at its top (its central directory, read over HTTP Range) and bundles its vocoder; terms URL is the one §6.1 of the bundled terms of use names.
